claude_proposed_widenings.name: reroll_saving_throw in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable's core mechanic is rerolling a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to fighter level. The v4 atom modify_roll_reroll exists (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9) but ClassFeatureEffect only exposes grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A new variant is needed to map modify_roll_reroll into class feature mechanics, requiring: a rollKind constraint (saving_throw), a class-level scaling bonus (LinearPerLevel<number>, axis=class, base=9, perLevel=1, startingAtLevel=9 — yielding the fighter level), and forced-keep semantics (must use new roll).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reaction in ClassFeatureActivationCost (trigger: on_save_fail)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable fires reactively at the moment the fighter fails a saving throw — not as a voluntary free or bonus-action activation. The current ClassFeatureActivationCost only models proactive activations (free, bonus_action). A reaction variant with a closed trigger condition (on_save_fail) is needed so the tracer can place the activation in the correct window. The v4 relation branches_on_save exists but has no class-feature-side surface analog.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it
